company_name: Mitsui Kinzoku Company, Limited (formerly Mitsui Mining & Smelting Co., Ltd.)

equity_bridge.item: Investment securities (cross-shareholdings and affiliates) at balance-sheet value, 30 June 2026
equity_bridge.note: Q1 FY2027 tanshin balance sheet line 'Investment securities' 63,704. Matching-asset rule: dividend and equity-method income from these holdings sit in non-operating income and are not in the EBITDA-based flows, so the asset is added once here. Listed holdings are carried at fair value under J-GAAP; no further haircut applied.
Q1 FY2027 tanshin balance sheet. Flows are 100% consolidated; NCI deducted once here (see inputs.nci_treatment).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Guidance-anchored base path (FY2027 +12.1% per August 2026 guidance, then decelerating to 2%), which averages ~5%/yr over 10 years. Equity 5yr CAGR (15.7%) rejected as the primary: it is inflated by the FY2025-FY2026 metals-cycle peak (net income JPY64.7bn and JPY91.3bn vs a JPY1.6-8.5bn trough in FY2020/FY2023) and is not a sustainable growth rate for a smelter plus materials group.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 17.6% vs revenue 3yr CAGR 5.2%: >30% divergence. The equity compounding reflects peak-cycle earnings retention in FY2025-FY2026, not organic growth of the revenue base; revenue growth is the better guide. EPS CAGRs are distorted by the FY2023 trough (JPY149/share) and FY2026 peak (JPY1,595/share) end points.
historical_growth.notes: FCF series is owner FCF = reported FCF (SBC nil, interest income not stripped because the company carries net debt), so reported and owner CAGRs coincide. 5yr FCF CAGR is undefined (FY2021 owner FCF was -JPY1.0bn). Reported FCF history is lumpy: -11.9bn (FY2017), +12.0bn, +5.4bn, +4.7bn, -1.0bn, +35.2bn (FY2022), +11.9bn, +43.7bn, +45.3bn, +51.6bn (FY2026) - the last three years are the metals up-cycle plus copper-foil ramp. All figures pre-split-neutral (CAGRs on totals, EPS CAGRs on the pre-split per-share series in the CSV).

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle, not peak. FY2027 lands on guidance (sales JPY850bn, EBITDA ~JPY124bn, 14.6%) as the FY2026 Metals inventory/FX/treatment-charge windfall reverses and scheduled zinc/copper smelter maintenance bites. From there Engineered Materials grows with VSP/MicroThin capacity (1,400 t/month by FY2030) while Metals is held price-neutral, so group revenue compounds 5-7% through year 5 and the EBITDA margin drifts to 15.5% on mix. Capex runs at JPY55-60bn/yr for the copper-foil build-out before easing toward D&A. Working capital absorbs 20% of every yen of revenue growth, which is what a smelter's inventory does. The JPY150bn 2030 ordinary-income target is NOT assumed.
scenario_narratives.bull: The AI-server copper-foil franchise (VSP, MicroThin, FaradFlex) scales on plan: revenue grows 8-11% a year through FY2031 as Taiwan and Malaysia capacity comes on, Engineered Materials margin expands with high-end mix and Metals delivers normal, not peak, smelting margins. Year-5 EBIT of ~JPY160bn matches management's JPY150bn ordinary-income target. Terminal EBITDA margin 18%, growth 2%. This is management's own plan delivered - it requires AI infrastructure capex to stay strong through 2031 and the Malaysia plant to ramp on schedule.
scenario_narratives.bear: FY2027 is fine (guided, Q1 +84% OP already booked) but it is the high-water mark: AI-server PCB demand plateaus in FY2028 as hyperscaler capex digests, new Asian copper-foil capacity (SK Nexilis, Chinese entrants) pressures VSP pricing, LME zinc and lead revert and the yen strengthens, pushing Metals back to the thin margins of FY2019-FY2020 and FY2024. Group EBITDA margin settles at 12%, revenue grows 2% nominal, and the growth capex program is scaled back. Catalysts (ICE motorcycles/autos) decline slowly throughout. Terminal multiple capped at 12x FCF for a commodity-exposed cyclical.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value a diversified Japanese non-ferrous metals and advanced-materials group on mid-cycle owner FCF, not the FY2026 record. The copper-foil growth engine is credited through revenue growth and a modest mix-driven margin drift; the Metals segment is held at normal margins; the ACT divestiture is a permanent base shrinkage absorbed in the guidance-anchored first year. Cross-shareholdings are added once (their income is outside the flows) and minorities deducted once. Risk is charged in the scenario weights (25/50/25), not in a scenario-specific WACC. Terminal value is capped at 14x FCF (12x bear) as befits a cyclical.
key_risks_to_valuation: Metals segment margin: FY2026 segment profit JPY75bn vs JPY44.5bn in FY2025 and a guided JPY24-37bn for FY2027; every JPY10bn of sustained Metals profit is worth roughly JPY120/share
AI-server copper-foil demand durability through the 2031 Malaysia plant start-up; the bull case is management's plan and needs this
Working-capital absorption on metal-price inflation: a 10pp change in wc_capture is worth ~JPY60/share in the base case
FX (JPY/USD) and LME zinc/lead/copper: company sensitivity ~JPY0.5-0.7bn ordinary income per JPY1/USD and ~JPY1-1.5bn per US$100/t zinc
Investment securities (JPY63.7bn) added at balance-sheet value; a 30% haircut for holding/illiquidity would remove ~JPY33/share
Terminal assumptions: the 14x FCF cap binds in the base case; the Gordon value at 8.5%/1.5% is higher, so value is capped rather than Gordon-driven

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of, post-split basis; 52-week range 1,427.5-5,770 (split-adjusted)
data_sources.financials: 5706.T_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, millions of JPY) FY2016-Q1 FY2027; FY2026 Annual tanshin (31 Mar 2026) and Q1 FY2027 tanshin (30 Jun 2026, filed 7 Aug 2026) for balance-sheet anchors, share counts, and FY2027 guidance; kpis table for segment revenue/profit, D&A, capex, cash taxes, interest income
data_sources.qualitative: 5706.T_Analysis.json (2026-10-31): ACT divestiture, 10-for-1 split, FY2027 guidance raised twice, 2030 medium-term plan, Metals one-off attribution

sanity_check_caveat: scripts/sanity_check.py divides post-split per-share values (IV, split-adjusted Yahoo prices) by the PRE-split share count still carried in 5706.T_Metrics.csv (57.2m; 10-for-1 split effective 1 Oct 2026), so every printed P/B and P/S - implied and historical - is 10x too low and the pass verdict survives by cancellation. Corrected by hand at base IV JPY1,563 (572.09m shares, market cap JPY894bn): P/B 2.17x vs FY2026 equity JPY412bn; P/S 1.18x vs FY2026 sales; P/E 9.8x FY2026 / 11.2x FY2027 guided; EV/EBITDA ~6.0x FY2026 peak / ~7.7x FY2027 guided. Properly scaled 10-yr averages: P/B ~1.46x, P/S ~0.65x; FY2026 year-end peak P/B 5.9x. The verdict (pass, inside historical range) stands on the corrected basis. Data fix belongs to the financial-parser: restate shares_outstanding x10 and EPS /10 across the CSV onto the post-split basis via make fix.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026 (year ended 31 March 2026) consolidated net sales, which still include ~JPY51.2bn of the divested ACT automotive-parts segment through 4 Nov 2025. The year-1 growth rate of 12.1% is set to land exactly on FY2027 guidance of JPY850bn, which is a post-divestiture figure, so the forward path is built on the continuing-operations base from year 1 onward; continuing-ops FY2026 revenue was ~JPY707bn, i.e. the underlying FY2027 growth is ~20% (copper-foil volumes plus metal-price pass-through).
inputs.share_count_basis: POST 10-for-1 split (effective 1 Oct 2026): 57,415,430 issued less 206,453 treasury = 57,208,977 at 30 June 2026 (Q1 FY2027 tanshin), x10 = 572.09m. No dilutive securities (FY2026 tanshin: 'Diluted profit per share are not stated since there are no dilutive shares'). Held flat: SBC is nil and there is no non-SBC issuance. Market quote verified post-split (Yahoo 52-week high 5,770 = pre-split peak 57,700/10; FY2027 guided EPS 139.83 is on the post-split basis).
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 balance sheet (Q1 FY2027): short-term borrowings 30,774 + commercial paper 11,000 + current bonds 10,000 + bonds 30,000 + long-term borrowings 37,852 = 119,626 (bonds and borrowings only; lease liabilities ~JPY1.4bn excluded, consistent with leases treated as operating cost). Cash and deposits 53,605. Net debt 66,021. Non-controlling interests (8,393) and investment securities (63,704) are in equity_bridge, not here.
inputs.sbc_source: Japanese GAAP filer; no share-based payment line in the FY2017-FY2026 cash flow statements or notes. Treated as nil (SBC-zero market), rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2026 interest income JPY704m is NOT stripped: the company carries net debt (JPY66bn), so there is no cash pile being double-counted. Dividend and equity-method income from investment securities sit below operating profit and are outside the EBITDA-based flows; the matching asset is added in equity_bridge.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the flows. 10y JGB ~1.7%; Japan ERP ~5.75%; equity beta ~1.2 for a materials group whose profit swings on LME zinc/lead/copper, JPY/USD and AI-server copper-foil demand -> cost of equity ~8.6%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~1% on JPY bonds/loans; debt is ~5% of EV. Blended WACC 8.5%, close to the ~9% house reference for JPY industrials. Same WACC in all three scenarios: cyclicality and the AI-capex concentration are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not a second time in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: J-GAAP: operating leases are already expensed inside operating profit, so the lease charge is in EBITDA. Lease liabilities (JPY1.0bn non-current + 0.5bn current at 31 Mar 2026) are excluded from net debt and no separate lease_cost_pct_path is applied. One treatment, applied once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are modelled on a 100% consolidated basis; non-controlling interests (JPY8,393m book at 30 June 2026; ~JPY0.5bn/yr of NCI dividends) are deducted once in equity_bridge. Not folded into the tax rate.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company route, dcf-methods routing table 'operating company, non-US or cyclical'), with the owner-fcf-adaptations applied: JPY-built WACC, single lease treatment, NCI deducted once in the bridge, investment securities added as the matching asset for the dividend/equity-method income excluded from EBITDA, SBC rows explicit at 0% (house and street coincide; band_position collapses). PEAK-EARNINGS JUDGMENT: FY2026 EBITDA margin of 21.2% (JPY160.7bn on JPY758.5bn) was a record that management attributes partly to non-repeating Metals inventory/FX/treatment-charge gains; the base case does NOT carry it forward. Year-1 EBITDA margin is anchored at 14.6% (FY2027 guidance: OP JPY94bn + ~JPY30bn D&A on JPY850bn sales) and drifts only to 15.5% as the higher-margin Engineered Materials mix rises; the 10-year history averaged ~13% including the low-margin ACT segment now divested. DIVESTITURE: ACT (automotive parts) sold to Hi-Lex on 4 Nov 2025 - treated as a permanent shrinkage of the base (handled through the guidance-anchored year 1), not normalised away. BALANCE SHEET: all anchors are the 30 June 2026 Q1 FY2027 balance sheet; the 10-for-1 split of 1 Oct 2026 is applied to the share count and the quote is confirmed to be post-split. MEDIUM-TERM PLAN: the JPY150bn FY2030 ordinary-income target is the BULL case, not the base.

bear.narrative: FY2027 guidance is met (Q1 already in hand) but FY2028 sees AI-server copper-foil demand plateau as hyperscaler capex digests, LME zinc/lead revert and a stronger yen compresses Metals; EBITDA margin falls to the 11.5-12% band of FY2018-FY2020 and FY2024. Capex is cut back toward maintenance. Terminal cap 12x for a commodity-exposed cyclical.

base.growth_rationale: Year 1 = FY2027 guidance JPY850bn (+12.1%, raised twice in May and Aug 2026; Q1 ran +19.3%). Years 2-5 of 5-7% reflect VSP copper-foil capacity rising toward 1,400 t/month by FY2030 with Metals revenue flat in volume and metal-price neutral; decelerating to 2% nominal by year 10 (Japan nominal GDP-type growth).
base.margin_rationale: FY2027 guided EBITDA ~JPY124bn (OP 94 + D&A ~30) = 14.6% of JPY850bn, well below the FY2026 peak of 21.2% because Metals inventory/FX/TC gains reverse and large-scale zinc and copper smelter maintenance lands in FY2027. Mid-cycle view: 10-year average EBITDA margin ~13% on a mix that included low-margin ACT; post-ACT mix with a rising Engineered Materials share (20% segment margin in FY2026) supports a drift to 15.5%, not a return to 21%.
base.capex_rationale: FY2027 capex guided at JPY56bn (6.6% of sales) vs JPY31-36bn historically, for VSP/MicroThin/FaradFlex capacity and the new Malaysia copper-foil plant (~2031 start-up). Capex stays above D&A through year 8 and settles at 4.8% vs D&A 4.5% - a maintenance-plus-modest-growth terminal state.
base.tax_rationale: Japan statutory ~30.6%. FY2027 guidance implies ~20% leakage from ordinary income to attributable net income (likely ACT-sale tax losses); ramped from 27% to the statutory 30% by year 4. Cash taxes paid were JPY19.1bn in FY2026 on ~JPY135bn pre-tax (timing), so the FY2026 cash rate is not a repeatable base.
base.wc_rationale: Smelter plus materials manufacturer: inventories (metal in process) and receivables exceed payables; FY2025-FY2026 operating cash flow lagged NI + D&A by ~JPY20-25bn/yr on JPY46-66bn revenue increases, i.e. 30-50% absorption, part of which was metal-price inventory revaluation. -20% of the revenue change is used as the structural capture rate.

bull.narrative: Management's 2030 plan delivered: year-5 (FY2031) revenue ~JPY1.22tn at a 17.5% EBITDA margin gives EBIT ~JPY160bn, matching the JPY150bn consolidated ordinary-income target (JPY130bn from Engineered Materials). Same WACC as base; terminal growth 2.0%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because half of revenue is a commodity smelting business whose margin has swung from 7% to 21% within four years and the FY2026 peak is already reversing; the AI-copper-foil thesis is real but concentrated in one product family and one end-market capex cycle. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it requires three independent things to go right (AI-server demand through 2031, Malaysia/Taiwan ramp on schedule, Metals margins holding at normal rather than trough) and management medium-term targets in this folder are treated as aspiration, not base. Base 50%: FY2027 guidance has been raised twice and Q1 is ahead of it.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
